handback.title: An empty repo reaches its first merge from the docs
handback.summary: Following only the install docs, an empty repo gets its first pull request merged.
handback.user_story: An owner with an empty repo gets to a first merged pull request with only the docs.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an owner sets up main's rule as the docs say, the required checks match the names GitHub shows.
acceptance_criteria.words: an empty repo reaches its first merged PR using only the docs
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The docs are fixed text; no input varies, and the test checks both pages.
